title: A Muse In’ Paradise Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: The brightly colored ‘Wash Ashore’ cottage is hard to miss, with a spectacular location close to Seaside Chapel, the playground, tennis courts and the family pool.
description_expanded: Description520 FOREST STREET1 KING, 1 QUEEN, 1 TWIN W/ TRUNDLE, 1 BUNK BEDRecently updated, “A Muse In’ Paradise,” has been freshened up with new furnishings and original art throughout the cottage. A Muse has a great location close to the Seaside Chapel, the playground, tennis courts, the family pool, and a short walk to the beach. Found on the eastern side, close to Seaside Avenue, the cottage offers a traditional floor plan, design elements, and charm. Multiple private outdoor spaces complement the home, including screened porches to enjoy the outdoor tropical landscape.The main gathering room is spacious and comfortable, offering ample seating, a smart TV, a sound system, and lots of natural light streaming in through the windows. This family room opens up to the galley-style kitchen, with abundant counter space and cabinetry for storage. A pass-through window from the sink looks into the dining area that comfortably seats six. The dining table is adjacent to an additional back den and game area. This sunny spot also has a television and an additional table. During cooler weather, guests enjoy the warmth of the Vermont cast iron gas stove in this cozy back den of the cottage. Finally, a full bath on the first floor also houses the washer and dryer.All three bedrooms are upstairs. The cheerful primary bedroom includes a king-sized bed, TV, private bath, and its own screened porch with plush furniture that overlooks Forest Street. One guest room includes bunk beds and a twin bed with an additional trundle; and the second guest room has a queen-sized bed. These two bedrooms offer a common screened porch that overlooks a wooded backdrop. Down the hall, these guest rooms lead to a shared full bath, or they may utilize the first-floor full bath.* 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3-night minimum; Fall 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURESFeatures 1732 square feetSeaside private residential beach at East Ruskin PavilionSeaside is the largest residential private beach on 30A528 yards or 6-minute walk to beach access65' new smart TVFull-sized washer & dryer on first floorClose to tennis courts, fitness center, adult pool, and family poolFront screened porch with swingPorches off of all three bedroomsOutside showerPeacock Alley premium linens – fresh, luxurious towels, sheets, etc throughout the cottageAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 Clay tennis courts, 3 Pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service and starter amenities are provided during your stayOnly 1 parking pass per one-bedroom cottage and 2 parking passes for two-bedroom and larger homes are issued. A golf cart is considered a car.Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit. No pets STR23-002294
